messages:
eve_support: forwarding customer report — tool call to `invoice_generator` fails with 400 'invalid tool args' when payload is pasted from Windows. customer says same payload works locally for them sometimes.

eve_support: customer payload (they pasted into chat):
```json
\uFEFF{\r\n  “invoice_id”: "INV-2026-001",\r\n  "amount": 1234.56,\r\n  "notes": "Payment for Q1 services",\r\n}\n```
(note the smart quotes, trailing comma and Windows CRLF; also customer mentioned there are percent signs in file paths elsewhere: "%20".)

alec_dev: can you include the exact curl / SDK call they used and any headers? which client?

eve_support: customer says they used Python requests via our SDK wrapper v0.9.2, curl repro they sent:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call-tool \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-***" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d $'\uFEFF{\n  "tool": "invoice_generator",\n  "args": "{\"invoice_id\": \"INV-2026-001\",\n             \"path\": \"C:\\Users\\Alice\\Invoices%20Q1\\\"}\n }'\n```

sophie_eng: thanks — three red flags: BOM (\uFEFF) at start, smart/curly quotes instead of ASCII quotes, and a trailing comma inside the JSON object. The percent-encoded path inside a JSON string is okay normally, but combined with weird quoting and CRLF we can get the parser to bail with our strict schema validator.

sophie_eng: repro steps I used: copied customer payload exactly (including CRLF + BOM) into a file and `cat -v` shows leading \uFEFF. Our JSON sanitizer pipeline wasn't stripping BOM when payload is wrapped in an inner string (args is a raw string). Reproducer:
```bash
# save payload as raw.txt (contains BOM + CRLF + trailing comma + smart quotes)
python -c "from pathlib import Path; print(Path('raw.txt').read_bytes())"
# POST with same wrapper
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/call-tool -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @raw.txt | jq .
```

alec_dev: nice find. so is the failure in our schema validator (rejecting invalid JSON) or earlier in our HTTP unmarshal? stacktrace?

sophie_eng: stack shows: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Invalid \udce0 escape at position 1` in validator; the payload arrives as a JSON string containing inner JSON with curly quotes and a trailing comma, so the inner parse fails before schema checks. I reproduced locally.

dan_oncall: temporary mitigation — strip BOM and normalize quotes before attempting inner parse, and reject trailing commas earlier with a helpful 400 message pointing to bad JSON in the tool args. I'll push a small sanitizer to staging now. @ci_bot can you run deploy? :soon:

ci_bot: deploy-bot: rolling out patch "sanitize-tool-args-bom-quote-fix" to staging (build 2026.03.17-19). Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2026.03.17-19 :rocket:

ci_bot: deploy finished for staging in 45s — smoke tests passed.

sophie_eng: quick patch notes: 1) trim leading BOM (utf-8-sig) on tool args payloads 2) replace curly quotes with ascii quotes inside inner JSON strings 3) run a lightweight trailing-comma check and return a 400 with example snippet when found. This should allow the customer's payload to fail cleanly or succeed after minor sanitization.

eve_support: forwarded to customer with workaround steps (save as UTF-8 without BOM or run `python -c "open('in.json','rb').read().decode('utf-8-sig')"` before sending). asking them to retry and report response. :pray:

alec_dev: if customer still hits it, ask them to attach the raw bytes of the POST body (or a hex dump). that will help.

eve_support: will follow up. closing here unless customer replies with new info.
